description: Capability for the Ideas companion window: the core set and TWO plugin rights, each exactly what the window uses. The opener's reveal, for Show in Finder (called only through app/src/onhost.ts), and the opener's open-url for http and https alone, so a link in a conversation opens in the browser. It reaches serve through the app's own commands (engine_connect) and its socket, and must not inherit main's opener, dialog, updater, process or notification rights: not opener:default (which would also allow mailto and tel), no open-path, no System Settings link.
